heading: The Story Behind the Pixel
paragraphs: Hello, I‘m Ali Reza; a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience building and scaling production applications across FinTech, EdTech, and data-driven products. My journey into technology began when I was a school student, working as a technician for a small ISP company. From there, my interest in computer science grew, and I knew I had found my calling.

Since then I‘ve worked across universities, startups, and freelance projects, growing from web developer to leading engineering teams. I currently lead full-stack development at FundEvolve, a Canadian-based financial wellness platform, where I build financial workflows, AI-powered insights, and advisor collaboration tools. I also co-founded BAMAA, where I lead engineering for YAR, an AI-assisted learning platform built for Afghan students.

I believe that technology is a powerful tool that has the ability to bring people together and make their lives easier, especially in a world that is rapidly changing and presenting new challenges. That‘s why I‘m dedicated to creating intuitive, user-friendly digital experiences that help businesses and individuals achieve their goals.

When I‘m not busy coding, you can find me exploring the great outdoors or enjoying a hot cup of coffee. Thanks for taking the time to get to know me a little better - I can‘t wait to work together and bring your ideas to life!
